text: dsh-mp4 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的视频预览插件，在右侧文档面板和 Better Sidebar 编辑器中注册 MP4、M4V、MOV 查看器。它读取工作区视频内容并交给浏览器原生 video 播放器，支持控件播放和进度操作；对读取失败或浏览器无法解码的文件显示提示。插件提供中英文界面文案，不要求 API 密钥或额外账号。
dsh-mp4 previews MP4, M4V, and MOV files in DSH’s web client. It registers sidebar viewers and plays workspace videos with browser controls. It needs no API key.
想直接在 DSH 右侧面板播放工作区里的 MP4 视频。
DSH 的文件预览不支持 MOV，能加一个浏览器视频播放器吗？
I want to preview an M4V workspace video in DSH’s sidebar.
dsh-mp4 的功能「右侧视频预览」：为 DSH 文档预览和 Better Sidebar 注册 MP4、M4V、MOV 查看器；打开匹配的视频文件时读取内容并显示带播放控件的浏览器 video 元素。
dsh-mp4 previews MP4, M4V, and MOV files in DSH’s sidebar using the browser video player.
dsh-mp4 README · dsh-mp4：Play **MP4 / M4V / MOV** videos inside the DeepSeek Harness **right sidebar** — the browser's own video player replaces the "this file type cannot be previewed" placeholder.

dsh-mp4 README · Why this exists：When the pane says *"this file type cannot be previewed / download to view"*, the file is fine. **No renderer claims mp4**, and which preview system opens a file depends on what you have installed:

dsh-mp4 README · Why this exists：| Your right column | What opens the file | Before |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-better-sidebar` installed | its `editor` tab, picking a viewer through `matchFileViewer(path)` | ships markdown / html / jsonl / code only, so mp4 falls through to the catch-all `code` viewer, reads as binary → "cannot be previewed" plus a download link |
| Native DSH sidebar | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview` | mp4 sits in `UNVIEWABLE_BINARY_EXTENSIONS`, matches no renderer → empty state, and not a single byte is read |

dsh-mp4 README · Why this exists：This plugin registers with **both**, so one package works on Desktop, plain `dsh web`, and any other profile. The two halves are independent: whichever system is missing simply stays idle instead of failing the plugin.

dsh-mp4 README · Install：Search `dsh-mp4` in the plugin market, or:

```sh

dsh-mp4 README · Desktop users: prefer Settings → Plugins (Desktop runs its own profile)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mp4
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-mp4
section: Desktop users: prefer Settings → Plugins (Desktop runs its own profile)

| Native DSH sidebar | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview` | mp4 sits in `UNVIEWABLE_BINARY_EXTENSIONS`, matches no renderer → empty state, not a byte read |

dsh-mp4 README · What it fixes：This plugin registers with **both**, so one package works on Desktop, `dsh web`, and any other profile. The two halves are independent: whichever system is missing simply stays idle instead of failing the whole plugin.

dsh-mp4 README · Install：Search `dsh-mp4` in the plugin market, or:

```sh

dsh-mp4 README · Desktop users: prefer the app's Settings → Plugins (Desktop owns its own profile)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mp4
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-mp4
```

text:
dsh-mp4 README · Format support：| Suffix | Supported | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `.mp4` `.m4v` | ✅ | H.264 + AAC is the safe case; HEVC/H.265 depends on platform and hardware decode |
| `.mov` | ✅ | QuickTime is ISO BMFF like MP4, so H.264 plays; ProRes / DNxHD does not |
| `.webm` `.ogv` | ❌ | Chromium supports them; this plugin simply does not declare them |
| `.mkv` `.avi` `.wmv` `.flv` `.ts` | ❌ | Chromium cannot demux these containers — renaming will not help; needs remuxing or an MSE demuxer |
| `.mp3` `.m4a` `.wav` `.flac` | ❌ | Needs an `<audio>` player instead of `<video>` |

dsh-mp4 README · Format support：Two things worth knowing: matching is **by suffix, not by codec** (an HEVC `.mp4` still fails, with an explanation rather than a black frame), and **playability belongs to Chromium** — the plugin only claims the suffix, reads the bytes, and hands them to the native element.

dsh-mp4 README · Known limits：- **Whole file in memory.** better-sidebar's `/sidebar/file` route answers without `Accept-Ranges` / `206`, so seeking waits for the download to finish. Fine for a few MB, slow for hundreds.
- On the native DSH path the read is capped by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-files` `maxFileBytes` (32 MiB by default).
- No transcoding, no thumbnails, no editing.

dsh-mp4 README · Uninstall：Remove it from the market or the plugin manager. Every registration (slots, the file viewer, the copy dictionary) is owned by a `ctx.effect` cleanup, so it disappears with the plugin; nothing is written to config, no host route is registered, no state file is left behind.

If you switched this viewer off by hand in better-sidebar's settings, that one `viewersEnabled` boolean stays in its preferences — inert.

dsh-mp4 README · Extending：One place: `EXTENSIONS` and `MEDIA_TYPES` in `client.js`. `webm` / `ogv` work as soon as they are listed; audio needs an `<audio>` element; `mkv` / `avi` / `ts` need host-side ffmpeg remuxing or a browser-side MSE demuxer.

dsh-mp4 README · Structure：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: an empty `apply`; the bundle patch needs a Host row |
| `client.js` | Browser half: both registrations plus the player component |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch inserting the `dsh-mp4` row |
| `locale/{zh,en}.json` | Title and description for the plugin page and market card |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon |

Everything it needs at runtime comes from the host: `slots`, `locale`, and optionally `betterSidebar` / `documentPreviews`.
